test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is one of the most important steps that can be taken to address climate change?

options.text: Investing in new coal power plants.
Reducing dependence on fossil fuels and investing in renewable energy.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes the importance of reducing our dependence on fossil fuels and investing in renewable energy sources such as wind, solar, and hydropower to address climate change.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4: Reducing dependence on fossil fuels and investing in renewable energy**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** The passage suggests reducing meat consumption, not increasing it.
 
• **Option 2:** Burning more fossil fuels is the main cause of climate change and would exacerbate the problem.
 
• **Option 3:** Investing in new coal power plants would increase fossil fuel use, which is counterproductive to addressing climate change.
